lines.say: This is Strata. / It runs Qwen3.8-Flash-Next / on a normal PC.
This voxel garden / came from one prompt, / written live / on an RTX 5070.
Inside is a team / of 24,576 small experts. / Each word / needs only 10.
So Strata shares the work / across your whole PC: / graphics card, / RAM / and processor.
